instruction: A TaskFlow progress comment for the Echo agent-harness build task.

content.body: Moved the task to Execution. Created two isolated worktrees: echo/spec-openapi for API contract and hybrid behavior docs, and echo/scaffold-core for the Python package scaffold, models, event bus, backend registry, app factory, and tests. Spawned Codex sub-agents Delta and Forge with bounded ownership and agentcom reporting.
